Vs.
Syeduddin Ahmed
full_judgment: 8. The plaintiff was an employee of the Bakerganj Collectorate. He stated in the plaint that he was granted settlement of 12'80 acres of agricultural lands under Mouza Char Acharya in 1952 but as the Char land was the subject matter of litigation he could not be given possession though he paid Salami and rent. He mentioned that in Misc. Case No. 699-R.A. dated 19-8-58, the then Commissioner Mr. W.B. Kadri, C.S.P. gave direction for settlement of some lands to the affected tenants of Char Acharya. He also prayed for settlement as he was affected tenant of Char Acharya. The Revenue Deputy Collector by his order dated 7.3.59 accepted the proposal for settlement of 5 acres of land with the plaintiff and accordingly direction was given to open a new Khatian in Register 1.
